family.description: This entry represents a bacterial immunoglobulin-like domain found in bacterial proteins, including Pesticidal crystal protein Cry22Aa from Bacillus thuringiensis, a protein with a toxic effect on several insect larvae and Chitinase 60 from Moritella marina ([swissprot:B1VBB0]), responsible for degradation of krill chitin.
family.name: Bacterial surface protein, Ig-like domain
